table_gt_generation.source: per-page .txt dumps embedded in MedCore_Catalogue_v2.pdf (zip container) + manual visual crop verification of both table bboxes to confirm exact row/column structure, header presence, and absence of merged cells.
notes: e0043 has a true header row (4 column labels) and a header column (bolded 'Feature' labels) — 14 total rows including header, 4 columns, no merged cells, confirmed by direct visual inspection of the cropped table region.

e0074 has NO header row in the source image — it begins immediately after the 'ServicePlus Plans' section title with the first data row ('Basic'). A 'headers' field (Plan/Price/Coverage) is included in the JSON for tooling convenience (e.g. Markdown rendering needs a header row to be valid), but `has_header_row` is explicitly set to False so structure-aware metrics (TEDS/GriTS) are not penalized for, or credited with, a header row that isn't actually present in the source.
